The '''2025 Retro League Event 4''' was the fourth event of the [[2025 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (3 August – 14 September 2025), played in [[Classic (no v-cards)]] format.<ref name="t85240" /> [[Andrew Bethell]] won.<ref name="t85240" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Classic (no v-cards)]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 3 August – 14 September 2025
* '''Players:''' 76 (in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Andrew Bethell]]

== Final standings ==
Final standings as posted by the tournament director (posted as text), in posted order. Tied players share a place.<ref name="p1440468" /> GEMP handles are from the organizer's participant lists and players' pages.<ref name="org2022" /><ref name="org2026" /><ref name="retro-85495" /><ref name="retro-gempc-86781" /><ref name="roster" /><ref name="slack-kb" /> Andrew Bethell and Benji Chu both went undefeated; a one-game tiebreaker decided the overall winner.<ref name="p1440468" />
